sample_unit: work unit leaders interviewed (plus workplace observation in 6 ICUs, approx. 559 nurses and physicians)
unlisted_practices: Co-design AI systems, tasks, and responsibilities using a sociotechnical framework (COMPASS) to preserve job autonomy, skill diversity, flexibility, problem-solving, and task variety
Design AI for transparency, predictability, and human control to reinforce clinician autonomy
Guard against deskilling of experienced professionals when introducing AI

screen.reason: The study conducts qualitative empirical research (workplace observations across 6 ICUs and interviews with 12 unit leaders) to evaluate how AI systems impact clinician work conditions and job characteristics through a sociotechnical framework, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
